absolute.measure: per-probe standard deviation of the first-order amplitude across the three repeats of one condition and speed

relative.measure: ||V - Vbar|| / ||Vbar|| per record, Vbar the complex mean of the repeats; balanced conditions excluded

note: Back-to-back only. The three repeats share one mounting of the added mass, so remounting variance is not included. Section 2.6 of the manuscript states this limitation.
